name: Kimberly

name: Valentina
text: We had an amazing days in this beautiful house. If you need a beautiful place to breathe pure air and have fun this is your place. Everything was exceptional.

text: We had a wonderful stay and would definitely recommend this property to other families. The host was extremely welcoming, responsive, and helpful throughout our stay. Overall, it was a fantastic experience, and we would gladly stay here again!

name: Merly
text: Great place to stay in, near almost everything.

name: Joseph
text:
Overall, this AirBnB was a good experience. It had all of the fun featured amenities (pool, hot tub, sauna, theater-type room, etc.). It had the proper amount of beds (the description listed less beds - only 4 queens and a twin, but it also had 4 bunk beds shown in the pictures). It was a good space to hang out with a large group gathering.

The biggest qualm I had with the AirBnB was the small water heater. The home's water system wasn't designed to accommodate large groups of people (we had 12). Even trying to space out showers amongst us was impossible, and the water was cold by the 4th person.
Another strange problem was that only about 2 of the 7 or so TV/projector remotes were working. One of our guests had to download universal TV remote to get by.
The third problem was relatively minor. A few of the lights were out - but it was survivable.

name: Eesha
text: Such a great host and a beautiful place! Would definitely recommend!

also, the house was well stocked with toilet paper and dish detergent.

text:
Had overall positive experience. House was clean, well-maintained, spacious to accommodate our group of 11. Entertainment options were good. TV in all room, pool table, foosball, poker table. Backyard was well maintained. Kitchen was well stocked with wide range of appliances & utensils. We particularly enjoyed the sunroom which has a projector as well.

There were minor issues that slightly affected our experience. The hot tub, while a great feature, had a slow heating rate, averaging just 1 degree per hour. So during our 2-day trip, we couldn't make full use of it on the first day. Additionally, we noticed there were no drains near the hot tub. The spilled water was accumulating & there were wires near the hot tub. The shower's hot water supply was limited, only accommodating 3-4 people before running out of hot water. Lastly, the dryer was notably inefficient or broken, as it took 6 hours to dry just half a load of laundry.

Despite these minor setbacks, we had great time overall.

The well-equipped kitchen, the cozy living area, the beautiful sun room, the fun game room to the spacious backyard offering panoramic views, every detail had been carefully curated to enhance the overall stay.
The hospitality provided by the host is outstanding. The combination of modern elegance, cleanliness, natural beauty, and exceptional hospitality created a perfect oasis for relaxation and rejuvenation. I cannot recommend this place highly enough to anyone seeking a peaceful retreat amidst nature with all the comforts.

name: Rhett
text: Edward was a fantastic host and made the stay easy and comfortable. It’s good to have an Airbnb that is straight forward and not looking to hide anything.

name: Corinne
text: Great place, more than enough space and very clean when we arrived. Would love to come back!

name: Samah
text: Edward was a very nice host. He made sure that he communicated with me throughout the entire stay if I needed anything he made sure that my experience with me and my family was good very nice very respectful definitely would book again. I hope everyone gives him a try beautiful house.

name: David
text: Me and a group of friends stayed at Eddie’s place Labor Day weekend and fantastic! Comfy beds w clean sheets and towels in each room. All amenities were as advertised and it was a very fun house to stay in. Eddie was very responsive, gave activity/food recommendations and overall an excellent host. There was an issue with the pool due to a recent storm and it was disappointing but Eddie got someone there to work on it immediately and they worked hard all weekend to get it swimmable by our last day. He was very apologetic and made it clear he was doing everything possible to improve our stay. He also went above and beyond by providing some compensation for the inconvenience and after our stay, proactively looked for feedback to improve future stays. All of that was 5 stars in my book and all of us there said we’d absolutely repeat the vacation with Eddie in the future. Thanks so much for hosting us!

name: Angela
text: The home was big, beautiful, clean and the host was very responsive. We loved the decor and the amenities such as the outdoor den area, hot tub, sauna and pool table. I love that the home was dog friendly and our group had enough space to enjoy themselves. The downside to the space was the water pressure was low, hot water was limited (signs indicated that we needed to schedule our showers apart to avoid running out of hot water). The pool and hot tub weren't clean and we werent able to enjoy it. I also didn't like that there wasn't any signs warning us about surveillance. There are cameras in the trees, one directly facing the pool and probably in other areas we didn't notice. The media room which had the hot tub and sauna smellled of mildew. Overall we had a nice experience.

name: Jeffrey
text: Eddie was a great host. Responsive, helpful and the house was just as expected.

name: Johanna
text: The house is very nice and cozy. We had a great time. I highly recommend.

name: Esther
text: We had a great time. The pool was clean and in an open area so we had the sun and weren’t cold from the shade, the outdoors was well kept, with place to play and relax. The house was clean and well kept. We stayed for a week and didn’t get bored. It was relaxing and enjoyable. The host was quick with communication and a pleasure to work with!

name: Avery
text: Looked just like the photos, offered everything we were looking for and had very comfortable beds.

name: Brianny
text: It was a beautiful place to stay with friends and enjoy some time away like a couples getaway however the jacuzzi water didn’t really seem clean and the hammock shown in the picture isn’t available. The lights outside the house don’t work neither. I recommend bringing ur own . And when we arrived there was still garbage from the previous guest. I also felt a little creeped out with two cameras extremely close and aiming at the pool. Though I will say the house is very beautiful. With lots of stuff to do inside as well as out .

name: Sean
text: Exactly what we were looking for. Highly recommend. Would come back.

name: Pasquale
text: Great spacious place for 8 people and 1 dog. Just went for a vacation and definitely would recommend !!

name: Laura
text: The house was nice and clean. The pictures posted are taken with a wide angle lens so the rooms are smaller than they appear in photos. The outside backyard needs lots of TLC. Weeds growing out of control on patio..molded cushions provided for wicker furniture on patio. Broken chairs provided for firepit. Ripped screens on window and sliding glass door in back. The inside of house was nice but again smaller in person than pictures provided online. Overall it suited our needs but backyard was not maintained at all. Lights surrounding backyard out of 100 only 8 worked. You get the drift.

name: Lashonda
text: Eddie was definitely an amazing host. House was exactly as described, felt right at home, had everything needed and more definitely did not want to leave, definitely will be booking again no question lol… Keep up the Great work Ed You rock 💯‼️

name: Claudia
text: We had a great time at Eddie’s place! Went for a reunion for group of friends and have a great time, the pictures looked exactly like the home. Eddie was responsive and gave clear instructions.

name: Ryan
text: Eddie was an awesome host. He sometimes even responded to my questions within a minute, it was crazy! The house looked exactly like the pictures and was very clean. Very clear instructions for check-in and check-out. Would definitely recommend!

name: Jialing
text: definitely a 5 Star airbnb to stay for long weekend!

name: Anita
text: We had a wonderful stay. Eddie was extremely responsive and helpful. I highly recommend!

name: Ian
text: Great stay, Eddie was very responsive and helpful. Fun place for a group of friends to get together.

name: Joseph
text: The house was just as described in the listing, Eddie was super responsive, good location near a lot of things to do/places to shop, thanks for a great time!

name: Tariq
text: Book with eddie! The house is amazing, and he is a great host. Would definitely stay here again!

name: Danielle
text: Fantastic weekend! Eddie was super communicative and the home was perfect. We had a great stay.

House had most of the basic amenities you could need and we were able to cook both nights using the kitchen and grill. Eddie checked in throughout the trip to see if we needed anything but we felt like we had full privacy. Terrific value and we all left really happy with the space.

name: Robert
text: Great house in a good location. Clean and well kept, easy to work with management, had a great experience!

name: Heather
text:
Best host i've ever had!
He went above and beyond to make sure we enjoyed our stay. They have everything you need to have a good time for all age ranges. Dont get me started on the jacuzzi!!!
10/10 recommend staying here

name: Ashly
text: Eddie was a great host. Very responsive and attentive to our needs. He addressed our concerns in real time during our stay and made sure we had what we needed and we’re comfortable. His place was very accommodating for a large group and packed with amenities and entertainment.

name: Deepan
text: Excellent place to unwind and relax. Excellent location for a large troupe planning for Kalahari water park or even just to laze around the house and hang about. Check in was very easy and instructions were very clear - I never really had to reach out to Eddie for anything.

name: Debbie
text: Wonderful stay ! House us fully equipped with entertainment. We had a great time !

name: Craig
text: Me and 7 friends rented the space to watch the ncaa wrestling championships. The house was exactly what we were looking for relaxing and plenty of space.

name: Sandra
text: Comfortable and clean home. I would recommend the stay.

name: Elly
text: It was a great stay, we enjoyed all of the amenities!

name: Tacey
text: Eddie was very friendly and quick to respond to any questions. His house was clean. Beds and linens were comfortable. House is located in a nice quiet peaceful neighborhood. Many activities and hiking areas close by. I would stay again.

name: Lina
text:
Eddie’s place was so much fun for a big group of people! There are so many activities between the projector, switch, board games, hot tub and pool, we always had something to do. The poker table was a personal favorite of ours.

I would advise a word of caution, the swinging chair in the sunroom is a tripping hazard, the black legs blend into the black rug so just be careful in that area especially if children are present. Also, the bottom rack of the dishwasher is a bit fussy and has trouble rolling back in. But other than that, I have no complaints, I would definitely recommend this place for a fun-filled stay.

name: Tameca
text: Second time staying at one of the locations. My group and I enjoyed our stay and look forward to our next ski trip next year. The location is great and have local things to do. The amenities made the stay worth it. We didn’t want to leave the house! Thanks for hosting us and we’ll be back!

name: Kelsey
text: We had one small concern at check-in, but Eddie addressed it very quickly and was very helpful and responsive. We had six adults and six children and we all had a really nice time! Would definitely go back!

name: Johan
text: Eddies little cove is very beautiful and a great place to visit if your in the area

name: Ashley
text: House was nice and exactly as expected. Owner was extremely nice, welcoming and had great communication. Awesome house…we would love to eventually come back to it.

name: Wayne
text:
Eddie's place had A LOT of beds. The house was very clean and well kept. The sauna is a Dry sauna so it wasn't as hot as i wanted it to be. The jacuzzi was hot but may make the garage smell a bit since it's located inside. The smell eventually fades so that was not a big deal.

There were also A LOT of cookware. This place has the most cookware I have seen compared to previous airbnb rentals. The balcony green house is also very cozy, there's a chance you can spot deers. They were feeding on Eddie's lawn, about six of them.

This house would be great for summer because in the backyard there was also an above ground pool, hammack and a fire place. A spacious area to hang out.

The 2 and a half bathrooms are perfect for large groups.

TVs, there are so many TVS! Eddie provided a nintendo switch and there were plenty of board games.

Eddie was very responsive, we communicated via Text message.
Awesome stay. Thanks

name: Victoria
text: My daughters and I had an amazing stay at Eddie’s during our holiday break. The house is pristine and super close to the Kalahari indoor water park. We will definitely be back!

name: Paige
text: Eddie was really great! Super helpful and responsive…would definitely stay at his place again. The space was as described with more than enough room for everyone in my group.

name: Daniel

name: Necol

name: Kelly
text: We had an absolute blast at this clean, chic and fun house. Just 9mins from Kalahari Resorts, this house offers a hot tub and sauna, game room, pool, fire pit, and projector room! What more could you ask for?! Absolute must stay.

name: Tyler
text:
A great home with plenty to do and a great backyard for enjoying the wilderness. The theater room and indoor game room were great for our group of guys. Beds were comfortable and the home was all well furnished.

Plenty to do around this area. 10-15 minute drive to most stores and breweries. There are neighbors close by, but were friendly and non-intrusive during our stay.

name: Kyle
text: Wei's house was a fantastic stay for a large group. We all slept great and weren't bored for a moment!

name: Raul & Val
text: Wei was a great host. Very helpful with any question or concerns we had. House is perfect for big groups and in a central location for all the activities in the area. I will recommend staying here if your looking for a good time in the Poconos.

name: Khanh
text: The host was very repsonsive and the place is very spacious. The pool and hot tub are great when the weather is nice. Favorite spot in the house is definitely the projector room! Great for hanging out with friends. Only thing to mention is there is quite a bit of wildlife in the area (We saw a bear next to the house) so keep that in mind when taking out the trash. Overall a great and relaxing stay.

name: Shaya
text: The house was perfect for families. Clean and spacious with great outdoor space for grilling swimming and relaxing. Most of all the hosts were so pleasant to work with and communicated in a very timely fashion. I highly recommend this house and host, and I know I would definitely love to return again.!

name: Lukas
text: Amazing place for a group weekend get together! Beautiful weather, good rooms, great kitchen. The host was extremely fast to respond - always within minutes!

name: Peter
text: clean, easy check in and check out so many things to do in the house with kids makes it easier to just stay in and hang out by the fire pit and movie room

name: Mir
text: Great vacation. Relaxing and good wholesome family fun. My family enjoyed the pool the grill and the fire pit. We enjoyed the games as well as the game room. It was clean and the hosts were very responsive. And the added bonus was the deer that visited the yard each morning.

name: Andy
text:
Everything was spectacular. Host was a great communicator, responded super quickly to any questions. Keypad entry made multiple arrivals as simple as can be. House was clean and well organized. Enough beds and sleeping areas for everyone.

Outside area was great and laid out well. We enjoyed our stay immensely.

Only thing I can think of for any improvement whatsoever was transportation in the area. Lyft and Uber weren't great options as rides were limited. So having a number of a local reputable taxi company would've been helpful. We found one with no major issue. But a recommended local company would've been very helpful.

No notes aside from that, the stay was just what we needed and expected. Thank you!!

name: Bernabe
text: Very beautiful house with lots of space. Great house to stay in for summer

name: Bindi
text:
I struggled to write this review as the hosts are definitely 5 stars: super communicative and ready to help! They even sent us donuts Saturday morning after our experience Friday night! But the experience was overall a 3.

My family and I rented for two nights and unfortunately ran into a lot of issues with things being broken or just not properly maintained to the point where they couldn’t be used. (Broken TVs/remotes, not a single game with pieces to play with, overwhelming smells, trash maintenance issues etc) At the $1700+/night price point I have rented MANY homes and the quality of this home did not meet the standard of the price point at all. The pool was amazing though! But otherwise, in general, we will not be returning or recommending. Thankfully I have given more details to the host and with fixes being made, future renters will have a more accurate experience that matches the photos (and maybe even previous reviews)

name: Helaina
text: The place is absolutely beautiful!!! The kitchen was full of supplies that we needed to make every meal with ease. The bedrooms are exactly as pictured and incredibly comfortable. We had such a wonderful time and the hosts were so helpful, from booking through checkout. Highly highly recommend.

name: Vivian
text: The house is beautiful spacious and there is plenty to keep you busy. My family and I had a nice relaxing week. The house was clean and the kitchen had everything that we needed. The response time for any questions that I had was great no more than a couple of minutes. I would definitely recommend.

name: Ivaldo
text: A lot of activities to do inside and outside the property. lovely stay for the price.

name: Angel
text:
Overall great house, our group of 12 was very comfortable + including an infant.

All the rooms are true to the pictures. The pool was clean and the game room very fun. Our large group had a lot of fun and everyone was able to do a bit of everything around the house with all the different entertainment options.

Wei made everything fairly easy to follow and we felt very welcome.

name: Isaura
text:
Great host!!!

name: Albarelis
text: Perfect and comfortable home for large groups. The place was very clean with many amenities. We had a great experience during our stay.

name: Andrea
text: Wei and Yue were wonderful host. House was very clean, communication was fast and home was just as described. Big enough for large groups but cozy enough for some games at night around the coffee table. I recommend 10/10. Thank you again Wei & Yue !!

name: Beat
text: Amazing! There are a lot of bugs outside so bring repellent but other than that everything is awesome!

name: Americo
text: Wei was a terrific host to our group. The spot was as described, and had all the amenities we needed.

name: Jasline
text: This house is amazing! It has so many acitivites indoors and outdoors. We played games, enjoyed the hot tub and sauna and even did karaoke. A definite must book home!

name: Erik

name: Ahmed

name: Fung

name: Jason
text: This was a fantastic spot! It wasn’t warm enough to open the pool, but everything else went great with plenty to do! Absolutely recommend this spot to anyone who wants a few days to get away, especially in the summer time.

name: Milissa
text: Wei & Yue are amazing hosts and were always so quick to respond. Our group had such a great time and the house really is fun for all ages. We plan to return!

name: Mahogany
text: We had such an awesome time !!! Everything was so clean and beautiful! It was so much to do just at the house .. also close to everything…..please book!! You won’t regret it!!

name: Boya
text: Our group had a great time staying at Wei’s house. Wei has provided clear instructions and always responded to our questions timely. Definitely recommend for a group getaway.

name: Evan
text: We had a great stay with 10 people for five days. Lots of fun games and facilities!!

name: Mark
text: Fantastic getaway! The entire house was exactly as described and better. We were only a short 10 minute drive to Camelback and Barley Creek Brewing, which was perfect for my group. Everything was spotless and cozy. I loved having so many amenities under one roof to enjoy at our leisure: hot tub, sun room, backyard firepit, BBQ, plenty of games stocked up. We can tell this family put a lot of hard work into making this a HOME. I can't even begin to talk up their gracious hospitality enough, it was more than appreciated. We would absolutely stay here again if given the chance

name: Tiffany
text:
This airbnb was an amazing find! My friends and I really enjoyed the cleanliness, the decors, and the amenities in the house. There were even board games and card games that were unopened in their packaging. We love the Jacuzzi and sauna. We also love how there are 2.5 bathrooms, so it's perfect for a big group.
The sun room can be pretty cold, but it is a perfect place for breakfast while enjoying some vitamin D. There are TVs in almost every room, so you can be listening to music / watching TV everywhere.
And Wei is a wonderful host! He responded to my messages in a timely manner and answered all my questions. He even accommodated the sudden changes to my trip. Honestly, this is a great airbnb! You won't be disappointed.

name: Anthony
text:
Nice house, all bedrooms on 2nd floor, all activities on 1st floor which is a nice set up. House was clean and well maintained. Be sparing with your chlorine usage in the hot-tub, if you put in a tablet and you leave it uncovered for a while, the room will begin to smell like chlorine (our mistake).

We had a great time, highly recommend.

name: Kelly
text: Couldn’t have asked for a better experience or a better host. The house was perfect and equipped with everything you can think of and Wei was super responsive and easy to keep in touch with!

Close to Walmart and Camelback resort.

Cheers.

The hot tub after a day of skiing was perfect!

text: We stayed for a group ski trip at camelback. The location was great, and the home was very clean and welcoming. Wei was very responsive and helpful, and the check in/out process was easy. Highly recommend!

name: Nehemiah

name: Rick

We would definitely stay again!

name: Jonathan
text: Great house and location. Check in and out were smooth, and communication was prompt. Wei even sent us some donuts via DoorDash, which was a very kind touch!

name: Te
text: Great place for family vaca. Definitely will come back during spring or summer.

name: Sophie
text: Wei’s place was beautiful, clean and organized. There was alot of amenities and fun things to do. Smooth check in and Wei is always quick to respond. Amazing host! Would definitely come back again!!!

name: Alexandria
text: Wei was an excellent host. He was very timely in his responses and very nice. The home was very comfortable and spacious for my family. We especially loved the game room with poker table and hot tub. I would highly recommend!

name: William
text: It was great to find such a beautiful place close to camelback for my whole family. While we only stayed one short night we enjoyed the hot tub, a few movies and a lot of good times. Highly recommend.

name: Jimi
text: Convenient location, great communication. Has all the basic supplies, but if you are planning to cook your own food definitely check with owners in advance to see what they provide.

name: Richard
text: Great place, stayed here with our party of 12 guests. Had a blast using the fire pit, the hot tub, and the sauna. The house felt spacious even for 12 and came with more amenities than even expected, such as Q-tips, towels, linens, floss, and a variety of plates, pans, and utensils. Wei had some of the fastest response time of any AirBnB host I have seen. The one and only thing I would point out is that the projector had a bright yellow spot in the middle of the picture, likely the lamp needs to be replaced, but that did not end up impacting our experience. Would recommend!

name: Mohit
text:
Wei is a great host! He took care of all our requests and made sure our stay was comfortable.

The place is accurately described and was a perfect getaway for our group.

name: Xing
text: Come here with group of friends for our short gateway trip.Had a great time in the house.Wei has been very helpful and always answer my questions quickly when we has any quesions.The house is very beautiful and cleaness.I would highly recommend.

name: Carlos
text: Fantastic house. I originally booked the house thinking 10 adults would be on this trip with us but only 6 of us were able to make it in the end. The kitchen is large enough that we were able to comfortably cook a Thanksgiving feast. Given the cold temps outside we didn't use much of the outdoor space but it seems like this would be a fantastic rental for warm weather too. The hosts were absolutely fantastic. They communicated clearly and frequently. They even had Dunkin Donuts donuts delivered to the house for us while we were there! I recommend this house and this host to anyone!

name: Michelle
text: My stay was amazing, everything was exactly as as pictured. My family and I had a wonderful time, I would definitely stay again. Wei is very responsive, I would highly recommend booking this property.

name: Christine

name: Ethan

name: Ginnel

Great place and location. It was a wonderful getaway to celebrate my son’s 3rd birthday with our family.

name: Kevin
text: Wei and Yue offer up their lovely home in PA and knock it out of the park. The house is exactly as pictured and is spotless upon arrival, immediately ready for you and your guests. If you're planning a getaway, you won't find better than a stay with Wei/Yue.

name: Aleudy
text: Owners communication was superb, had minor issue and was fixed right away, Place was spacious and clean. I recommend it lot others already, well worth the price. 5 star!

text: The house was exactly what we needed for our group of 12 that came together for a gathering after being apart for too long. Wei was extremely responsive before and during our stay, and the house itself has all of the basics you need to have a chill and relaxing weekend in the Catskills.

text: Perfect for a bachelorette getaway - super fun amenities in the home & nearby wineries. The home itself was immaculate and Wei was very communicative, helpful, and responsive. 10/10 would recommend!

text:

name: Joseph

text:

Wei was super responsive in answering questions. Kitchen was well stocked. Bring yard games like corn hole to make the most of the back yard!

name: Jia
text: Beautiful home! Super cute decor! My family had a great time! We loved the sunroom, hot tub, outdoor pool, and fire pit. Comfortable beds and enough sleeping space for 13 people! Washer/dryer was also helpful to have! Wei was available whenever we had questions. Would recommend!

text: Wei communicated the whole time was available if I had any questions responded fast and was polite. House was jus as described on website with more for my 1st time renting an Airbnb for myself and family it was a great experience.

name: Nabeela
text: I stayed at Wei’s place for my bachelorette weekend with 8 other girls and we absolutely loved the place! It has summer vibes written all over it and truly is a unique find in the poconos. The decor is top notch, modern, and very aesthetic for bachelorette party photos! The theater/movie house was our favorite spot, but we also enjoyed the backyard grill/patio. Wei was accessible whenever we needed via message, super friendly (sent us breakfast treats), and left clear instructions for check-in and check-out. I would highly recommend this place for anyone looking for a unique and fabulous time in the Poconos!

name: Kamilla
text:
Amazing getaway in Poconos !

One more good thing is that this place was dog friendly
Looking forward to come back and try to spend time there during winter holidays
Thank you guys for your hospitality !

text: Host went above and beyond to meet our needs. 100% recommend.

name: Abi
text: The house is absolutely stunning! From stylish furniture, to amazing amenities, this house has it all! Everything was exactly as pictured! The house was absolutely spotless when we got there. The beds were extremely comfortable, with soft linens and plush blankets, as were the towels for the shower and hot tub! The hot tub was AMAZING, and was definitely the best feature of the house. The theatre room is also a great plus, and was able to keep us warm with giving the feel of being outdoors with the surrounding glass windows! And any problem I ran into (there weren’t many, I just couldn’t turn on the fireplace), the hosts answered immediately and walked me through it. They were so helpful and hospitable. Was definitely one of the best trips I’ve ever been on, and will definitely rebook in the future!

The location is great too, very convenience to Walmart, Aldi, Lowe's, mountains, hiking trails. Will definitely come back again.

name: Natalia
text: Wei’s place was very clean and had everything we needed to enjoy the weekend. We were a group of 9 - enough space for all of us, beds were comfortable, kitchen was equipped and Wei was very quick in responding all my inquiries.

text: We had a great time at the Wiki Cabin. Exactly the getaway we were looking for!

name: Laura
text: We loved staying at Wiki Cabin. We were visiting the poconos to go hiking, to be outdoors and some peace and quiet. This house is close to a lot of hiking trails and 40 mins away from Bushkill falls (strongly recommend, specially in the fall). It’s also very close to camelback and other surrounding attractions. There is a Walmart 5 minutes away, as well as an Aldi, so it was very easy to get groceries. The house was sparkling clean, which is very important during these times. The beds were comfortable and rooms were spacious. The house was packed with family friendly activities, that we took full advantage of every day. The backyard is huge, they have a nice hot tub and a fire pit that we used to stay warm and make some s’mores! Our favorite thing about this house was that it’s per friendly so we were able to bring our two fur babies. We had a small inconvenient and the hosts were very quick to respond and help us sort it out, they were wonderful and we can’t wait to stay at wiki cabin again.

name: Trinae
text: This is the place to stay in Long Pond! The hosts were super responsive and very helpful with all of the information they provided leading up to and during our stay. Due to the COVID-19 pandemic, we haven't had much of a summer so my husband and I decided to rent a house to bring our immediate family and friends together for our son's first birthday. The house was sparkling clean and tastefully decorated. There was space for everyone without feeling crowded. The kids and adults loved the amenities that this house offered: Pool table, air hockey, Pool, hot tub, bubble tent, games, etc. We loved our stay!! This is our 4th time traveling to the Long Pond area for a family getaway over the last few years and this is by far the BEST house we've stayed in. I wish I could buy this house from them, that's how much we loved it! The spacious kitchen, great floor plan, the sunroom with projector for movie night was a huge hit with everyone! We will surely return for our next Long pond visit. Thank you Wei and Kelsey for the amazing hospitality!
